## QrCode.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: Text or URL encoded in the QR symbol.
- `ecc` :: Reed–Solomon error correction level.
- `pixelSize` :: Logical pixel size per QR module.
- `quietZone` :: Blank margin modules around the symbol.
- `shape` :: Corner shape around the QR container.
- `label` :: Accessible label describing the encoded destination.
- `alignContent` :: How the symbol sits inside the frame. @default 'xcenter'
- `overlay` :: Optional centered logo or badge snippet (use high `ecc` like `'H'`).
- `surface` :: The surface behind the symbol: fill, border and shadow in one choice.
- `overlaySurface` :: The surface of the chip that holds the overlay snippet.
- `textSize` :: The scale of that error message.
- `textColor` :: The ink of that error message.

## qr-encode.ts

### `type QrCodeEcc`

Error-correction level, lowest to highest redunancy.

### `interface EccLevel`

- `table` :: Row index into the two per-block tables.
- `formatBits` :: The three format bits this level writes.

### `interface Segment`

One run of encoded text in a single mode.

### `interface QrMatrix`

What `qrEncode` returns: the module matrix plus how it was decided.

- `size` :: Rows and columns, border included.
- `data` :: `data[row][col]` — true is a dark module.

### `interface QrEncodeOptions`

- `ecc` :: Error correction. Default `L`.
- `boostEcc` :: Use the highest level that still fits. Default `false`.
- `minVersion` :: Default 1.
- `maxVersion` :: Default 40.
- `maskPattern` :: -1 picks the best mask by penalty. Default -1.
- `border` :: Quiet zone, in modules. Default 1.

### `function qrEncode`

Encode `value` into a QR module matrix.

### `function qrPatternPath`

Serialize the dark modules of a matrix into a single SVG path.
